intro: 这是vLLM Ascend v0.26.0的首个候选版本，与上游vLLM v0.26.0保持一致。此版本为模型受限版本，完全验证的模型包括Kimi K3、GLM‑5.2、DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731和DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813。其他模型的可用性不保证。完整测试报告请参见： v0.26.0rc1测试结论 。请按照 官方文档 开始使用。

intro: This is vLLM Ascend v0.30.0rc1, a model-focused release built on the v0.29 release line and aligned with upstream vLLM v0.30.0 via the main2main pipeline. This release focuses on four flagship models: DeepSeek V4.1 , GLM-5.3 , GLM-5.3-Flash , and Qwen3.8-27B , and hardens the shared execution stacks they rely on (Model Runner V2, PCP/DCP parallelism, KV Cache Pool, and speculative decoding). Model or hardware combinations outside the scope declared below are not part of the release claims. Please follow the official documentation to get started.

intro: This is vLLM Ascend v0.30.0rc1, a model-focused release built on the v0.29 release line and aligned with upstream vLLM v0.30.0 via the main2main pipeline. This release focuses on four flagship models: DeepSeek V4.1 , GLM-5.3 , GLM-5.3-Flash , and Qwen3.8-27B , and hardens the shared execution stacks they rely on (Model Runner V2, PCP/DCP parallelism, KV Cache Pool, and speculative decoding). Model or hardware combinations outside the scope declared below are not part of the release claims. Please follow the official documentation to get started.

intro: 这是vLLM Ascend v0.26.0的首个候选版本，与上游vLLM v0.26.0保持一致。此版本为模型受限版本，完全验证的模型包括Kimi K3、GLM‑5.2、DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731和DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813。其他模型的可用性不保证。完整测试报告请参见： v0.26.0rc1测试结论 。请按照 官方文档 开始使用。
